meaning:
ἐξ-ουδενέω
(Rec. -όω; T, -θανόω), -ῶ, [in LXX (with vv. ll. -όω, -θενέω, -θενόω) for בּוּז, בָּזָה, מָאַס, בּוּס, etc. ;]
to despise, set at nought: Mrk.9:12 (cf. ἐξουθενέω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
